agents.summary: Confirmed official stage identity, 23 km, 5-7 h / 1 day / easy, route order, side/rest points, cycling note, official sources and stale-source risks.
Found Hjo harbor and Baståsen endpoints, two official GPX segments stored reverse to official order, tiny Baståsen duplicate/backtrack, OSM 1690568 continuity and E1 partial-geometry caveat.
Collected Hjo, Stämmorna, Högaliden, Hedsmossen, Kärrabo, Pershov and Baståsen facility/access decisions, including Hedsmossen and Kärrabo water caveats.

Confirmed Hjo busstation as strong start access, Åkarp as a candidate access point, Baståsen A/B as current line-402 stop names with coordinates/connector pending, and old Rödåkra/line 405 as stale/suppressed for current import.
Found 2025 reverse-direction passability evidence, 2026 Hedsmossen/Högaliden water planning notes, Pacer route-app listing and older Komoot/blog context.
Researched Hjoåns dalgång restrictions, adjacent protected-area caveats, fire-ban status, dog/livestock/hunting rules, forestry bbox hits and Baståsen road/access safety.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Initial six-lane pass is strong enough for research-complete handoff. No targeted follow-up was spawned because remaining issues are normalization/import checks: GPX reversal/deduplication, exact protected-area overlay, exact forestry polygon-to-route-buffer intersection, Hjoåns dalgång fire legality, Baståsen access verification and water reliability.
